trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Oil Disruption
trends.summary: U.S.-Iran ceasefire failing to restore oil traffic through Strait of Hormuz; Iran capping transit at ~15 vessels/day vs. normal 135/day, with only ~55% chance of normalization before July 1. Trump administration actively managing geopolitical tension while White House warned staff against market timing bets on Iran developments. Direct impact on crude prices and energy sector valuations.

trends.name: AI Model Safety & Systemic Risk Concerns
trends.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent and Fed Chair Powell summoned Wall Street leaders over Anthropic's new Mythos AI model posing potential systemic risk. Reflects escalating concerns about AI development pace, regulatory oversight, and competition between OpenAI and Anthropic. Market implications for AI infrastructure, chip stocks, and financial stability.

trends.name: Record Global M&A Activity in Q1 2026
trends.summary: Global M&A transaction values jumped 18% YoY to $1.25 trillion in Q1 2026, largest Q1 on record, including Unilever's $44.8B food sale to McCormick and Sysco's $29.1B deal. Strong dealmaking signals corporate confidence, sector consolidation trends, and potential multiple compression in acquirer stocks.

trends.name: China Economic Recovery & Factory Price Growth
trends.summary: China's factory-gate prices (PPI) rose 0.5% YoY in March, first growth in 3 years, while CPI came in at 1.0%. Recovery driven by Iran war oil price surge and reflects improving manufacturing demand. Critical for commodity prices, EM currencies, and growth expectations for Chinese exporters.

trends.name: Fed Policy & Core PCE Inflation Re-Acceleration
trends.summary: 6-month core PCE inflation jumped by the most since June 2024, signaling potential challenge to Fed's rate-cut narrative. Critical amid geopolitical uncertainty (Iran war) and commodity price inflation risks. Complicates Powell's policy trajectory and could constrain equity valuations if inflation proves stickier than expected.

trends.name: Tech Stock Divergence & Software Sector Weakness
trends.summary: Significant divergence emerging within tech sector with software stocks lagging hardware/chip stocks. Reflects investor concerns about AI disruption, SaaS valuation sustainability, and hardware beneficiaries of AI buildout. Portfolio rotation implications and sector-level risk for growth-weighted positions.

trends.name: Consumer Inflation & Food Price Pressures
trends.summary: Iran war inflation spreading to consumer goods; grocery bills rising and snack food pricing (Doritos at $7) driving consumer pressure. Pepsi lost billions in revenue from aggressive pricing on consumer staples. Threatens consumer discretionary demand and retail earnings, particularly for mid-market retailers.

trends.name: Bank of Japan Balance Sheet Contraction
trends.summary: BoJ total assets fell $98B in Q1 2026 to $4.14 trillion, lowest since Q2 2020. Since Q1 2024 peak, BoJ reduced balance sheet by $590B (-12.6%), with JGB holdings down $84B in Q1 alone. Signals tightening monetary conditions in Japan, impacts yen strength, and raises global liquidity concerns.

trends.name: Fed Leadership Transition & Bessent Treasury Role
trends.summary: Kevin Warsh Fed chair confirmation hearing delayed amid political uncertainty. Simultaneously, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent elevated role in financial stability decisions (AI risk meeting with Powell). Unclear policy direction and fragmented regulatory authority creating near-term uncertainty for markets.

trends.name: Geopolitical Instability & Market Rally Sustainability
trends.summary: Cease-fire rally showing signs of exhaustion as analysts question sustainability; ground troop movements near Middle East suggest potential for resumed conflict. Recent corrections in equities following initial relief rally suggest markets may have moved too fast on peace assumptions. Risk/reward shifted less favorable for growth-oriented positions.

trends.name: Bitcoin Breakout Test & Crypto Momentum
trends.summary: Bitcoin defending support for two months, poised to test key resistance at 73.5K. Breakout could propel to 90K. Reflects broader asset class rotation interest and inflation hedge positioning amid macro uncertainty. Relevant for crypto exposure and portfolio diversification strategies.

trends.name: Earnings Season Reality Check & Valuation Risk
trends.summary: Q1 earnings season underway with Netflix and major banks facing critical moment as cease-fire rally coincides with results. Corporate profits remain healthy but pricing power pressures emerging (Pepsi, consumer goods). Risk that market valuations extended ahead of earnings growth justification, particularly in software/SaaS segments.
